title: nutty dense Brazilian genmaicha stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew from Brazil featuring nutty genmaicha tea and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a low-sodium dinner option.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the genmaicha tea, brown rice, diced tomatoes, water, and chopped spinach to the pot.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Shred the cooked chicken and return to the pot for easy serving.
